question: Does emulsion grain formed before scanner gate-weave sampling differ materially from an otherwise matched screen-space grain residual added after gate weave?

primary_control.title: AOMedia Film Grain Synthesis Technology v2
primary_control.use: Current post-decoder film-grain synthesis as an explicit screen-space ordering control, not as a physical emulsion model.
excluded: claim that codec grain is physically wrong for its intended use

forbidden: move physical grain after scanner sampling in the retained reference chain
reinterpret codec or display grain as developed emulsion structure
change frames, trajectory, grain profile, controls or gates after formal scoring
claim this synthetic ordering test measures a film transport, scanner or video product

branch_rule.pass: freeze developed emulsion grain before scanner gate-weave sampling and keep screen-space codec grain as a separate control or product layer
branch_rule.fail: close the ordering distinction without grain, offset, frame or threshold rescue

claim_ceiling: Synthetic physical-order evidence separating developed emulsion grain from post-decoder screen-space grain only; not measured film, scanner, codec quality or video product readiness.
